# MVS Analyzer 1.4.0

[![Download for Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Windows%20x64-0078D6?style=for-the-badge&logo=windows&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/d1d2dopamine/MVS-Analyzer/releases/download/v1.4.0/MVS_Analyzer_v1.4.0_win-x64.zip)

- Separate within-entity and between-entity spread analysis with individual power estimates.
- Additional variance and estimation tools, plus experimental repeated-measures MELSM.
- Restored results layout and optional Colab execution with verified calibration reuse.
- Fixed strict JSON export, private-runtime discovery and Windows/Linux calibration checksum compatibility.
- Clearer user documentation and cleaner download packages.

The Windows x64 build is self-contained. MELSM remains experimental; inspect diagnostics and method assumptions before use.
